description: This Swift source file contains extensions for the ChannelsSettings class, adding various SwiftUI views and helper functions related to displaying and managing channel configurations and actions, including sections for WhatsApp and generic channels, as well as buttons for login, logout, refresh, and save operations.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: A class or structure representing the settings for channels, extended in this file.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a section with a title and content, using SwiftUI's GroupBox and VStack for layout.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides a bar of buttons for actions like logout and refresh on a given channel.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Constructs the UI section specific to WhatsApp channel including login, QR code display, and relink options.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Creates a configuration section for a generic channel identified by its ID.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Defines a section with configuration editing, save, reload buttons, and status messages.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the current configuration status message if available.
